redirectPath.label: Redirect Path (Optional)
redirectPath.helpText: If set, the user will be instantly redirected to this path after successful enrollment, skipping the success page.

showLoginButton.label: Show Login Button
showLoginButton.helpText: Display the login button on the success page if not redirecting immediately.

content.label: Success Page Content (Optional)
content.helpText: Custom content to display on the success page. Overrides the default message. You may use HTML.
content.tokensSuffix: They are replaced at runtime with the course title and the amount the learner paid for their selected plan.

collectBillingContactDetails.label: Collect Billing Contact Details
collectBillingContactDetails.helpText: Let learners add a separate billing contact (name, email, role) during enrollment. The billing email also receives invoices and renewal notices.

billingContactFields.heading: Billing Contact Fields
billingContactFields.helpText: Customize the labels learners see, mark fields optional, and (for the third field) supply dropdown options as a comma-separated list. Leave the options blank to render it as a free-text input.

options.label: Options (comma-separated)
options.helpText: Leave blank to render this field as a free-text input.
